name: turbo-luxury-mcp
description: Mobile car wash in Abu Dhabi: packages and AED prices, package recommendation, outdoor wash-window score, monthly care tips and a prefilled WhatsApp booking link.
long_description: Lets an AI assistant answer customer questions for Turbo Luxury Car Wash, a mobile car wash in Abu Dhabi that comes to the customer's location. It lists the four packages (Quick Shine, Golden Shine, Diamond Shine, Detailing Shine) with AED prices and inclusions, recommends the cheapest package that covers a car's needs, scores whether the weather suits washing outdoors from temperature, wind, dust and humidity, gives a car care tip for each month of the Abu Dhabi climate, and builds a WhatsApp link with a prefilled booking message that the user sends themselves. All tools are read-only, with no API keys and no outbound network calls.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List the mobile car wash packages in Abu Dhabi with prices in AED and what each includes.

tools.name: recommend_package
tools.description: Recommend the cheapest package that covers the stated needs (wax, deep interior clean, engine bay, sanitization, stained seats, AC smell, hazy headlights).

tools.name: wash_window_check
tools.description: Score the current outdoor washing window in Abu Dhabi from temperature (C), wind (km/h), dust PM10 (ug/m3) and humidity (%). Give at least one.

tools.name: monthly_care_tip
tools.description: Get the car care tip for a month in Abu Dhabi climate (1 = January, 12 = December).

tools.name: booking_link
tools.description: Build a WhatsApp link with a prefilled booking message for a package. The user opens it and sends the message; nothing is sent automatically.
